shots.purpose: Open on a single crimson maple leaf: the red presented as a mystery, not an explanation
shots.claim: yellow autumn colors are unmasked by chlorophyll loss, but the red is newly synthesized each autumn
shots.evidence: full-bleed plate: one crimson maple leaf with fine vein linework on cream stipple paper, no cause shown yet
shots.motion_reason: slow push-in so the leaf reads as the subject
shots.transition_reason: cut into the familiar shutdown story

subject_contract.expected_subject: botanical plate of a single crimson maple leaf with fine vein linework on cream paper

shots.purpose: Show the textbook start: chlorophyll dismantled, pale yellow carotenoids finally visible
shots.claim: chlorophyll breakdown in autumn unmasks yellow and orange carotenoids already present in the leaf
shots.evidence: diagram card: a leaf fading from green to yellow along its length, a green pigment band draining out, yellow dots appearing beneath
shots.motion_reason: near-static drift so the green-to-yellow gradient is the motion

subject_contract.expected_subject: botanical diagram: leaf fading green to yellow with a draining green pigment band and yellow carotenoid dots

shots.purpose: Split the misconception: yellow was hidden, but red is manufactured fresh this fall
shots.claim: red autumn color comes from anthocyanin synthesized fresh in the leaf during autumn, not from a hidden pigment
shots.evidence: split card: left, a yellow leaf under a green veil (hidden all along); right, a crimson leaf stamped NEW with brewing marks
shots.motion_reason: held framing; the hidden-versus-new contrast is the information

subject_contract.expected_subject: botanical split: yellow leaf under a green veil on the left, fresh crimson leaf on the right

one_second.relationship: yellow was hidden; red is new

surprise.evidence: the leaf surface resolves into a cell sap view: sugars and light building a new pigment molecule in place

shots.purpose: Show the brewing conditions: trapped sugars plus bright cool light building anthocyanin in the cell sap
shots.claim: autumn conditions — trapped sugars, bright light, cool temperatures — drive anthocyanin synthesis in the leaf
shots.evidence: cross-section card: a plant cell with sugar dots and a sun arrow entering, crimson anthocyanin dots filling the vacuole
shots.motion_reason: drift across the cell so the sugar-to-pigment conversion is the motion

subject_contract.expected_subject: botanical cross-section: plant cell with sugar dots, a sun arrow, and crimson anthocyanin dots filling the vacuole

one_second.relationship: sugars and light brew the pigment

shots.purpose: Show the leading hypothesis: the red shields the leaf while nitrogen and valuables are salvaged down the stem
shots.claim: one leading hypothesis is that anthocyanin protects the leaf's nutrient-recovery process from excess autumn light
shots.evidence: card: a crimson leaf with sun rays blocked by a red shield band, nutrient arrows flowing down the stem
shots.motion_reason: drift along the salvage path so the shield-and-recover relationship is the motion

subject_contract.expected_subject: botanical plate: crimson leaf, blocked sun rays above a red shield band, nutrient arrows flowing down the stem

shots.purpose: Show the honest state: three competing ideas, no winner — sunscreen, antioxidant, pest signal
shots.claim: why leaves synthesize anthocyanin remains debated: sunscreen, antioxidant, and pest-defense hypotheses all compete
shots.evidence: three-panel card: SUNSCREEN (blocked rays), ANTIOXIDANT (calmed molecule), PEST SIGNAL (warning marks), a question mark over all three
shots.motion_reason: held framing; the three-way panel contrast is the information

subject_contract.expected_subject: botanical triptych: three small leaf panels labeled sunscreen, antioxidant, pest signal with a question mark

one_second.relationship: three ideas compete for the red

shots.purpose: Land the argument on the falling leaf at dusk: the red was built at the end, as the tree salvaged and the leaf let go
shots.claim: autumn red is an active, resource-spending process that accompanies the tree's final nutrient recovery before leaf fall
shots.evidence: dusk reprise: the crimson leaf drifting down with a clean scar at the stem, warm light, calm palette
shots.motion_reason: slow pull-out, the frame settles as the argument does

subject_contract.expected_subject: botanical plate of a falling crimson leaf at dusk with a clean stem scar, warm calm light

one_second.relationship: the red was built at the end; the leaf lets go
